answer: A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, since the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The pearl multiplier is published, charged in reef, and haven lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 15 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 1238 identities would post 1511 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
